items.title: Dreamy Trash Pandas
items.creator: Tetrascape
items.description: Rules? Never heard of them. Calm? Don’t know her. Pure, unfiltered, trash panda energy. Embrace the chaos—these dreamy raccoon skins are calling your name.

items.title: Cute Shops
items.creator: KiwiStars
items.description:
Turn your world into a bustling marketplace with Cute Shops! This cozy and colorful Add-On lets you craft and place adorable themed shops right in your favorite world.

- Craft and build charming shops anywhere you like
- Buy fun and unique items from each themed store
- Customize your town or village with a lively shopping district
- Created By KiwiStars

items.title: Mob Fusion
items.creator: A30x1
items.description:
- New world creation is always a random seed!
- 4500+ UNIQUE COMBINATIONS (With each mob abilities)
- Capture ANY MOB with your capture ball, even fused mobs!
- Each mob fusion has a unique ability, endless gameplay possibilities!
Have fun ;)

This item uses random start areas for any new world. Endless possibilities!

items.title: Horror Teens
items.creator: Snail Studios
items.description: Create and invoke stylish horror! Teen entities emitting horrific energy, embrace the dark aura of six scary teens!

items.title: WITHER APOCALYPSE 1.1
items.creator: Team Workbench
items.description:
What happened to the Wither? IT’S OP! Can you survive its dangerous powers? Summon the Wither Wraith and watch it turn the overworld into a dark wasteland. Try your best to survive and obtain the powerful weapon!

- A massive Wither Boss with dangerous abilities
- Biomes slowly turn into Withered Lands
- New powerful Wither Weapons
- New Withered Mobs
items.changelog:
Wither Apocalypse 1.1:
+ New Withered Mobs
+ New Withered Beacon
+ New Dash Ability
+ Settings menu
+ Further Corruption Optimisation
+ Boss AI Tweaks
+ Many smaller fixes and improvements

Good luck out there!

Hop into action with these adorable frog-themed outfits!

By Pathway Studios & Luladeer Games

A secret squad of masked adventurers has arrived! Will you keep your identity hidden or reveal the real you? Team up, explore, and uncover the mystery together!

+ Perfect for roleplay!

items.creator: 2-Tail Productions
items.description:
Combine high-tech power with shadowy mystery and explore like never before! Are you ready to gear up and glow in the dark?

+ 11 scary skins
+ Perfect for roleplay!

items.title: Cyber Monsters
items.creator: 2-Tail Productions
items.description:
Enter the future with the Cyber Monsters! Pick from a lineup of fierce, high-tech creatures glowing with RGB colors. Light up your world and stand out in every adventure!

+ 12 bright skins
+ Perfect for roleplay!

items.title: Weapons Evolve
items.creator: Misfits
items.description:
WEAPONS EVOLVE! 
Evolve your vanilla weapons in new special weapons and add :

+ New ARMORS!
+ Special Effects and VFX!
+ Custom structures generation!
+ Dungeon System
+ New Abilities for your weapons!

items.title: Dark Teens Megapack
items.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming

Embrace your dark and edgy sense of fashion with these 80 modern and trendy teen skins! Own the darkness!

- 80 modern teen skins
- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming

items.title: Pony Cuties
items.creator: Block Perfect Studios
items.description:
Add a few colorful rainbows to your world with the Pony Cuties skin pack by Block Perfect Studios! It's perfect for Role Play or adding a bit of fun to your day!

- 10 Cute Pony-Themed Skins

items.title: Nightmare Glow
items.creator: Big Dye Gaming
items.description:
Unleash the Glow of Nightmares. Transform your gaming experience with the Nightmare Glow skinpack!
Perfect for those who dare to stand out in the dark, these skins are your ticket to dominating the battlefield with style.

• Featuring eerie luminescent designs!
• Have fun!

By Big Dye Gaming

items.title: Craftable City
items.creator: Bunny Studios
items.description:
Welcome to Craftable City! Start with an empty plot and unleash your creativity—craft buildings, place them wherever you like, and decorate interiors with stylish furniture. Build your dream city block by block in this fun and customizable adventure!

+ Bunny Studios

items.title: Glitch Teens
items.creator: QwertyuiopThePie
items.description:
Show off your dark aura to your friends. Upgrade your skin with a 3D glitch effect!

+ 12 skins
+ Dark 3D glitch effect

items.title: Anime Nightmares
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description: Dare you embrace Anime Nightmares? This dark horror collection summons scary legends whispered in shadow. Become a phantom warrior, a cursed samurai seeking vengeance, a stealthy dark ninja mastering forbidden arts, or a terrifying Japanese demon pulsating with malevolent horror. Beware their sinister glowing eyes watching from the deep, creatures embodying fear itself.

items.title: Craftable Modern Houses
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
What’s more fun than living in a massive mansion? Crafting it yourself! Jump into a new world with friends, grab some items, and start building mansions with just a few button presses.

+ 21 unique houses
+ Customizable

This item uses random start areas for any new world, offering endless possibilities!

Made by MineParty, published by Waypoint Studios

items.title: Rainbow Monsters

Become the ultimate entity with an overwhelming aura and strike fear into your enemies!

Made by Butterfly Games, published by Waypoint Studios.

items.title: Hardcore Wilderness Survival
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
HARDCORE WILDERNESS SURVIVAL is a vast, untamed world where danger hides around every corner.

+ Ultimate survival challenge
+ 500x500 custom world
+ Discover hidden treasures
+ Defeat the Ender Dragon
+ Mob ambushes
+ Plenty of structures to explore
+ Immersive adventure experience 

Designed for Hardcore mode - one life, no second chances. Good luck!

items.title: Invisible Hideout
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Invisible Hideout is the most secure, hidden, and epic secret base ever! It's packed with advanced rooms, hidden vaults, mob arena, stealthy entrance, and much more.

+ Giant underground bunker
+ Mob arena
+ Working elevators
+ Modern build
+ Perfect for survival and role-playing
+ Many secret rooms, hidden treasures, and much more
+ Multiplayer friendly
+ 8 custom skins

By: Plank
